The '''Karthakk sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], [[Maramere]], and [[Nod Kartha]].

==History==
The [[Karthakk resistance]] was active in the sector during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. It later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as the [[Karthakk Sector Force]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
